name: Apploye
description_en:
Apploye combines time tracking and project timesheets with employee activity monitoring, screenshots and reporting. Managers configure what is collected while workers’ activity becomes time and productivity data.

A monitored keyboard/mouse percentage is an activity signal, not a direct measure of business output. This profile separates those measurements from billing, payroll calculations and the vendor’s claimed productivity improvements.
description_zh:
Apploye 结合时间追踪、项目工时表、员工活动监测、截图和报告。经理配置采集范围，员工活动形成时间及生产力数据。

键鼠活动百分比是活动信号，不直接衡量业务产出。本文区分这些测量、计费/薪资计算，以及厂商宣称的生产力改善。

core_features.explanation_en: Track time against projects/tasks for reports and invoice preparation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按项目/任务追踪时间，用于报告及发票准备。

core_features.explanation_en: Per-user screenshot/activity/app settings and plan-specific collection limits apply.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按用户配置截图/活动/应用监测，受档位采集限制。

en: Prepare a team, project/task IDs and the tracking client, then start a representative work session. The plan table describes offline tracking with later synchronization. Compare the final timesheet, idle classification and exported project total after reconnection; do not assume the same behavior for every desktop state.
zh: 准备团队、项目/任务标识及追踪客户端，再开始代表性工作。套餐表介绍离线追踪后同步。重新联网后，应对照最终工时、空闲分类及导出项目总额，不能默认所有桌面状态相同。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Free Starter or per-user paid subscriptions by cadence, with monitoring limits and separate screen-recording add-ons.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free Starter or per-user paid subscriptions by cadence, with monitoring limits and separate screen-recording add-ons.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Starter 免费或按周期付费用户订阅，监测有限制，屏幕录像另加。

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: a project session with an offline interval
sections.title_zh: 示例：含离线时段的项目工作
sections.en:
Prepare a team, project/task IDs and the tracking client, then start a representative work session. The plan table describes offline tracking with later synchronization. Compare the final timesheet, idle classification and exported project total after reconnection; do not assume the same behavior for every desktop state.

Decide screenshot, URL and background-monitoring policies before installation. Activity percentages can miss reading or offline work and should not alone determine pay or performance. This is evaluation guidance, not an observed employee session.
sections.zh:
准备团队、项目/任务标识及追踪客户端，再开始代表性工作。套餐表介绍离线追踪后同步。重新联网后，应对照最终工时、空闲分类及导出项目总额，不能默认所有桌面状态相同。

安装前先决定截图、网址及后台监测政策。活动百分比可能遗漏阅读或线下工作，不应单独决定薪资或绩效。这是评估建议，未实际观测员工。

sections.title_en: Free capacity and paid collection depth
sections.title_zh: 免费容量与付费采集深度
sections.en:
Starter is free up to ten users, with limits including three clients, screenshot and URL quantities. Elite shows $7 per user monthly, $6 quarterly and $4.50 annual monthly equivalent; Power shows $12, $10.50 and $8. Confirm final currency, tax and seat rules.

Power adds real-time screenshots and deeper classifications/detection. Screen recording remains an add-on across paid columns. A screenshot limit is not a storage/retention promise, and a free tier is not unlimited surveillance capacity. No paid checkout or collected data was tested.
sections.zh:
Starter 最多十位用户免费，限制包括三位客户、截图及网址数量。Elite 月付每用户 $7、季付月均 $6、年付 $4.50；Power 分别为 $12、$10.50、$8。最终货币、税费及席位规则需确认。

Power 加实时截图及更深分类/检测；屏幕录像在付费列中仍为附加项。截图额度不是存储/保留保证，免费档也不意味着监测容量不限。未测试付费结算或采集资料。

sections.en:
Remote operations teams can evaluate the time-to-project workflow, while a team seeking only voluntary personal focus tracking may not need the monitoring scope. Establish who may inspect or correct records and reconcile approved time before creating payroll or invoices. A calculation/export is not a completed wage payment.

No permissions, deletion, licence, deployment contract, actual application detection or recovery was verified. Missing activity should be checked against client state and sync history before treating it as missing work.
sections.zh:
远程运营团队可评估时间到项目的流程，只需自愿个人专注记录的团队可能无需这一监测范围。应明确谁可查看或更正资料，生成薪资或发票前核对已审批时间；计算/导出不等于工资已支付。

未核实权限、删除、许可、部署合同、实际应用识别或恢复。把活动缺失视为未工作前，应先检查客户端状态及同步历史。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No client, monitoring, offline sync, privacy permissions, export, payroll, licence or recovery tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试客户端、监测、离线同步、隐私权限、导出、薪资、许可或恢复。
